name: MDN Web Docs
body: A content security policy built on default-src 'self', two-year HSTS, framing denied, and Core Web Vitals that pass for real visitors. The gap: no page analyzed carries JSON-LD naming who runs the site.
lesson: Add one Organization block with name, url, logo, and sameAs links. AI answers use it to name and describe you.
summary: developer.mozilla.org scores 95 out of 100 (A). 0 checks fail now, 9 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: permissions-Policy is not sent.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 12 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: No llms.txt was found
fix.evidence: /llms.txt returned 404. It is a proposed convention that some AI tools read to find the pages that matter.
fix.fix: Publish /llms.txt. The fix kit has a draft built from this review.

fix.title: No security.txt
fix.evidence: /.well-known/security.txt returned 404. Researchers who find a flaw have no published way to report it.
fix.fix: Publish /.well-known/security.txt with Contact and Expires. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: No structured data was found
fix.evidence: No JSON-LD block was found on the pages that were analyzed.
fix.fix: Add Organization or Person, WebSite, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
